info.title: Actual HTTP Api
info.description: Actual Budget write surface via the actual-http-api sidecar (https://github.com/jhonderson/actual-http-api), authenticated with the x-api-key header. Amounts are integers in minor units (12030 = 120.30).

x-auth-vars.name: ACTUAL_HTTP_API_KEY
x-auth-vars.description: The API_KEY you configured on your actual-http-api sidecar (not your Actual server password).

page.name: page
page.description: Page number. When limit is set, this parameter is required. Example 2

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Number of rules to return. When page is set, this parameter is required. Example 50

budgetSyncId.name: budgetSyncId
budgetSyncId.description: This is the Synchronization ID from Actual Budget → Settings → Show advanced settings → Sync ID

budgetEncryptionPassword.name: budget-encryption-password
budgetEncryptionPassword.description: Optional encryption password for end-to-end encrypted budgets. You may need to provide it again after a service restart or Actual API client reset before reopening a cached encrypted budget

cutoffDate.name: cutoff_date
cutoffDate.description: Account balance cutoff date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Example 2023-08-20

payee_name.description: Only available in a create request

subtransactions.description: Only available in a get or create request

post.summary: (🔧 Extended) Imports a budget from an Actual export or a YNAB4/YNAB5 file.
post.description: 🔧 Extended: Uses the official importBudget API, returning the sync id of the imported budget. Note that importing a budget that already exists does not restore it in place: the Actual library clears the file's server identity on import, so the budget is uploaded as a new file and receives a NEW sync id. The original budget and its sync id are left untouched.

parameters.description: The format of the uploaded file

parameters.description: Used to derive the budget name when importing YNAB files

requestBody.description: The raw budget file. Actual and YNAB4 exports are zip files, YNAB5 exports are JSON

syncId.description: The sync id of the imported budget, used by every other endpoint

post.description:
Moves money from one category to another for one specific month.
If the source category is not specified the money will come from available to budget.
If the destination is not specified the money will go to available to budget.

get.summary: Gets the balance for an account. If a cutoff is given, it gives the account balance as of that date. If no cutoff is given, it uses the current date as the cutoff.
(🔧 Extended) Gets the balance history for an account, from start to end date, with daily granularity. Until date is optional, defaults to today.
get.description: 🔧 Extended: Uses official library APIs with additional business logic or transformations.

put.description:
transferAccountId and transferCategoryId are optional if the balance of the account is 0, otherwise if the account has a non-zero balance, you need to specify an account with transferAccountId to transfer the money into.
If you are transferring from an on-budget account to an off-budget account, you can optionally specify a category with transferCategoryId to categorize the transfer transaction.
